integrity: Full proof and reproducible executable accompany the result. No independent scientific audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only two uniform edge-price classes on wheels, freely adjustable nonnegative conductances, ordinary continuous-time combinatorial-Laplacian spectral gap, and exact linear budget. No assertion about discrete-time fastest mixing, weighted vertex measures, heterogeneous prices within edge classes, or degree-constrained network design. Analytical all-order proof is supplemented, not replaced, by finite tests.
title: Rim-price rigidity and a flat optimal face for fastest diffusion on wheels
